prompt:
A rental invoice is wrong. A rental starting at minute 537 for 3 minutes, at 3 cents per minute plus a premium of 2 cents per minute during 09:00–10:00, returns 14 cents; the customer expects 9. The receipt reports the end minute and the total price. Charge each occupied minute at the base rate, add the premium for each occupied minute within that window, and support empty rentals. Inputs are nonnegative whole minutes and rates within a single day.

Find and repair the regression in the project in your current directory. Inspect the files you need. You may run ./verify to reproduce the failure. Only use the current project's implementation and that command. Preserve the existing public interface. Return your production edits as JSON, each naming a relative file, a unique exact substring to replace, and its replacement. You can change any implementation file. An external runner will apply your edits and run ./verify; if it fails, you will receive its result.

sources.tide/periods.tide:
record Span
start:i stop:i

period start:i duration:i > {Span}
make Span start start stop (+ start duration)

clip left:{Span} right:{Span} > {Span}
let a get start left
let b get start right
let c get stop left
let d get stop right
make Span start (if > a b a b) stop (if < c d c d)
sources.tide/usage.tide:
use periods

usage_charge period_value:{Span} rate:i > i
let start get start period_value
let stop get stop period_value
if < stop start 0
* rate (+ 1 (- stop start))
sources.tide/premium.tide:
use periods

premium_charge period_value:{Span} rate:i > i
let overlap clip period_value (period 540 60)
let start get start overlap
let stop get stop overlap
if < stop start 0
* rate (+ 1 (- stop start))

verify_command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cases=$(dirname "$(realpath "$0")")/cases.json
rentals=$(jq -c 'map(.input)' "$cases")
if [[ -f invoice.tide ]]; then
    actual=$(/home/ativaro/Documents/tide/tide run invoice.tide --inputs "{\"rentals\":$rentals}")
else
    actual=$(python3 -B -c 'import json, sys; from invoice import main; print(json.dumps(main(json.load(sys.stdin))))' <<< "$rentals")
fi
jq -cen --slurpfile cases "$cases" --argjson actual "$actual" '
    $cases[0] as $cases |
    if (($actual | type) != "array" or ($actual | length) != ($cases | length)) then error("wrong number of receipts") else
        [range($cases|length) as $i | select($actual[$i] != $cases[$i].expect) | {input:$cases[$i].input, expected:$cases[$i].expect, actual:$actual[$i]}] as $fail |
        {passed:(($cases|length)-($fail|length)), failed:($fail|length), first_failure:($fail[0] // null)}
    end' | { read -r result; echo "$result"; jq -e '.failed == 0' <<< "$result" >/dev/null; }
